dispute.claim_text: My receipt says Rivervale Drive to Changi Terminal 1 and it says 26.2 km. I have taken this exact trip many times and it is 21 km. On top of that he drove around the airport for another five minutes before dropping me. $33.77 for a trip that is usually about $28. Why am I paying for him driving in circles?

counterparty_statement.text: She moved the pickup to Punggol MRT before I got there, then in the chat she changed to Terminal 3. At T3 she was not at the kerb, I went round the loop twice looking for her and she came out at the other end. I drove exactly where the app told me.

admissibility.notes: Trip record complete, and carries both amendment timestamps, both pre-amendment endpoints, and the platform's re-quote between the amended endpoints as amended_optimal_distance_km 24.60 and amended_optimal_duration_min 31.0. POL-RD-05 reads those two fields; the figure is not to be derived by the Judge.

admissibility.notes: Unbroken 10 s telemetry, 100% coverage. Shows the T1 approach, the inter-terminal link after the 07:41:52 amendment, and two loops of the T3 departure kerb well inside 380 m of the amended pin.
Four messages. The rider's own pin move and terminal change are both recorded here and acknowledged by the driver.

admissibility.notes: Line items reconcile to the cent. No airport surcharge: this trip ENDS at Changi rather than originating there, so none is chargeable.

issue_details.detail: No advisory applies, and none is needed: POL-RD-05 and not POL-RD-03 decides this case.
